title: How To Do The Robot In Real Life (Fortnite Dance Tutorial #22) | Learn How To Dance

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher is very methodical, breaking down each movement into small, manageable parts. He uses a repetitive, step-by-step approach to ensure the viewer understands the mechanics of each move.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher performs the full dance routine.
The teacher introduces the tutorial and acknowledges viewer requests.
The teacher breaks down the first part of the dance, focusing on arm movements.
The teacher adds upper body movement to the arm movements.
The teacher introduces the counting scheme for the routine.
The teacher practices the routine at a slower tempo.
The teacher explains the arm release and the importance of locking the elbow.
The teacher adds leg movements to the routine.
The teacher recaps the full routine with counts.

metaphors: the first swing uses force to create the swing, but then you need to relax
common_mistakes: moving everything below the elbow instead of including the elbow

steps_taught.name: Robot Arm Swing
steps_taught.description: A rhythmic arm movement involving a swing and a stop.

steps_taught.name: Robot Body Lean
steps_taught.description: A lean forward combined with arm and elbow movements.

steps_taught.name: Robot Leg Step
steps_taught.description: A leg lift and a small step to the front.

what_works: The teacher breaks down the movements into very small, manageable parts.
The use of a mirror angle helps the viewer follow along easily.
what_hinders: The counting scheme is quite complex and might be difficult for beginners to follow.

quotes.text: So, your wish is my command.
Okay, so let's take it from the tip-tap.
And the secret here is to lock from your elbow and up.
From here, we want to look on seven to our left.
Okay, let's try it from the tip-tap.
